payload.label: Search Internet Archive
payload.job: Search Internet Archive for books, articles, audio, concerts, films, images and other primary sources, with license and collection filters and source provenance for any objective
payload.description: Free, read-only Internet Archive Advanced Search. Supply Archive's query syntax; the request always adds NOT access-restricted-item:true and returns a bounded page with identifier, title, creator, date, year, media type, collection, licenseurl, rights, description and access-restriction metadata when indexed. Query examples: (title:tennis AND mediatype:movies); (creator:Example AND collection:georgeblood); (mediatype:audio AND licenseurl:*creativecommons.org*). A license URL or unrestricted access is evidence to inspect, not proof of permission for your intended use. Preserve the item identifier and source metadata; missing or ambiguous rights remain unknown. The Archive's George Blood 78rpm description limits use to research, teaching and private study and says copyright was not transferred; concert recordings also need item-specific rights review. Search results only; this does not download or save media.

query.description: Internet Archive Advanced Search query. Filter with mediatype, collection and licenseurl fields; the tool also excludes records flagged access-restricted-item:true. Use a license filter to narrow discovery, then inspect each item's rights for the exact intended use.

rows.description: Maximum number of results in this page (default 25, maximum 50).

provenance.source_rights: Each result's rights and license fields are item metadata, not blanket permission to reuse.

payload.label: Read Internet Archive item metadata
payload.job: Inspect one Internet Archive item's original metadata, license, rights, collection and available file listing before deciding whether it fits an objective
payload.description: Free, read-only lookup at Internet Archive's metadata endpoint. Accepts only an item identifier and returns the original metadata and available file listing, including creator, dates, collection, license/rights statements and access details when present. No media bytes are downloaded. Record the returned identifier and its canonical item page, https://archive.org/details/<identifier>, as provenance. Archive hosting or an available file does not establish permission to reuse. Missing or ambiguous rights stay unknown; independently check the item and collection against the intended use. The George Blood 78rpm collection states research, teaching and private study only and says copyright was not transferred; concert recordings need item-specific review too.

identifier.description: The identifier returned by Archive Search or present in an archive.org/details/<identifier> item URL. Do not send a URL or path.

provenance.source_rights: Metadata preserves source assertions; it does not establish a general reuse right.
